Proposals: Option 1: The study conclusion and output on initial CDLC model A1 (based on 38.827 FR1 Uma CDLC model) can captured in conclusion part and Annex part for reference. (Ericsson) Option 2: RAN4 to introduce in the body of 3GPP TR 38.753 exclusively references to the relevant section, subsection, or equation from a target release of 3GPP TR 38.901, without any duplication of the content. Additional text can be included in 3GPP TR 38.753 to explain any change on top of the referenced procedure, or to further detail the choice of parameters, or the implications. (Qualcomm) Option 3: The TR conclusion to capture comparison results by collecting and aggregating the feedback given by all contributors. Additionally, it may be attempted to make a general statement on the necessity of SCMs

[CR CR0002r1 for 37.828] Reason for change: There is no coexistence simulation result in clause 5.2 without any explanation. Summary of change: Clarify that the simulation results and conclusion that have been recorded in the approved TR 37.880 can be applied. Consequences if not approved: Ambiguity remains and would lead to misunderstanding.

[8] (ran4_cr_chunks 38.847, sim=0.492)
